claims.quantifiers: For every finite shared coordinate set X, every disjoint private U,V, and all Boolean f(X,U), g(X,V)
claims.statement: The singleton potential of fg is bounded by coefficient-one private X-orbit charges plus |X| times the smaller empty-orbit charge; the associated block potential contracts under every physical reveal order.
limitations: shared block must be fixed rather than changing through the hierarchy
does not yet pay the complete signed Delta_i U charge
not a proof of full FEI
